DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 歩道について、何か気になる所がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you notice anything concerning about the footpath?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩道の落ち葉の下に、穴のような所がありました。足を入れそうになったのでお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 落ち葉下の穴らしい箇所で踏み込みそうになったと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was what looked like a hole under the fallen leaves on the footpath. I nearly stepped into it, so I wanted to report it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you nearly stepped into a spot that looked like a hole under fallen leaves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: けがはありませんか。今はその場所から離れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you injured? Please move away from that spot for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: けがはありません。池の手前の曲がり角です。落ち葉をどけて調べることはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無傷で池手前の曲がり角と未調査の状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not injured. It is at the bend just before the pond. I have not moved the leaves to investigate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are unhurt, the spot is at the bend before the pond, and you have not investigated it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所を確認します。ほかの方が近くを通っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the location. Are other people passing nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 何人か通っていました。私がずっと立って止めるより、担当の方に確認していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通行者がいるので職員による確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: A few people were passing. I would like a staff member to check, rather than stand there myself stopping people indefinitely.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask staff to check because people are passing by. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで対応を確認します。場所を示す目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check how to respond. Is there a landmark to identify the spot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 低い木の横です。この案内図で印を付けてもよいですか。木だけだと似た場所が多いと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 低木横の場所を案内図で具体化したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is beside a low tree. May I mark it on this map? I think there are many similar places if I describe only the tree.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Offer to pinpoint the spot beside a low tree on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内図で位置を確認しましょう。確認までは近づかずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us confirm the location on the map. Please wait without approaching it until it has been checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。ここで示してから別の道を使います。同行者にも、その曲がり角を避けるよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 位置説明後に別の道へ移り同行者にも知らせると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. After showing you here, I will take another path. I will also tell my companions to avoid that bend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after explaining the location, you will take another path and inform your companions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 知らせてくださりありがとうございます。それでは、こちらで確認します。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. We will check it. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方にも、乗り方をご説明しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like me to explain how to ride to your companion as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。友達は日本語がまだ難しいので、私が訳します。ただ、一度に長い説明だと覚えきれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者のため訳すが長い説明は覚えにくいと依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, please. My friend still finds Japanese difficult, so I will interpret. However, I cannot remember everything if the explanation is long and given all at once.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation for your companion, saying you will interpret but find long explanations hard to remember. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 短く区切ってご案内します。まず、どちらへ向かいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will explain in short sections. First, where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人でこの行き先です。友達は私とずっと一緒なので、別々の行き先を案内する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人同一行先で一緒に移動すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: We are both going to this destination. My friend will stay with me throughout, so you do not need to explain separate destinations.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you both have the same destination and will travel together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、切符の確認から説明します。分からない言葉があったら止めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then I will start by checking your tickets. Please stop me if there is a word you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今の「乗り換え」は、途中で別の電車へ移る意味ですね。そこを友達に伝えてから次を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗換語義を確認し友人へ訳してから次の説明を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. The word transfer you just used means changing to another train along the way, correct? I will tell my friend that before listening to the next part.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the meaning of transfer, then interpret it for your friend before hearing the next explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。その理解です。必要な確認を一つずつ進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, that is correct. Let us go through the necessary checks one at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友達が何を持って改札へ行くか質問しています。私が答えを想像せず、切符を見せてもう一度聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の改札質問を推測で答えず切符を示し再質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend is asking what to take to the ticket gate. I would like to show you the ticket and ask again, rather than guess the answer myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the ticket and ask again about your friend’s question about the gate, without guessing the answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切符に合う利用方法をご案内します。お二人とも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain how to use your particular ticket. Please both check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。友達にも分かったか聞きます。私が理解しただけで終わらず、二人の準備ができてから進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両者の理解と準備を確認してから移動すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will also ask my friend whether they understand. I will not stop at understanding it myself; we will proceed once we are both ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm both people understand and are ready before moving on. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、切符をご確認ください。お二人ともお気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check your tickets, then. Have a safe journey, both of you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのようなご用件ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What can I help you with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 地区の集会で話した歩道について、市に意見を届けたいです。議事録も持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩道に関する集会意見と議事録を提出したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to submit comments to the city about the footpath we discussed at our neighborhood meeting. I have brought the minutes as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about submitting the meeting’s comments on the footpath and its minutes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身のご意見でしょうか。それとも集会でまとめたものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are these your own comments, or comments compiled at the meeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 集会で出た意見です。ただ、全員が賛成したわけではないので、全員の要望とは書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 全員賛成ではない集会意見と明確に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are comments raised at the meeting. However, not everyone agreed, so I have not described them as a request from everyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that these are meeting comments that did not have unanimous support. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 意見を受け付ける担当と、提出の方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will direct you to the department that accepts comments and explain how to submit them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。議事録には関係のない話と参加者の連絡先もあるので、そのまま出してよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無関係の話と連絡先を含む資料の提出範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. The minutes also contain unrelated discussion and participants’ contact details, so I would like to check whether I should submit them as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which parts of documents containing unrelated discussion and contact details should be submitted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な内容や資料の扱いも、担当にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also consult the department about the information needed and how the documents will be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。歩道についての部分が分かるようにして、元の議事録も確認用に持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 歩道該当部分を整理し原議事録も確認用に持参する旨述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will make the section about the footpath easy to identify and bring the original minutes for reference as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will organize the relevant footpath section and bring the original minutes for checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 回答を希望する場合の連絡方法も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check how they should contact you if you would like a response.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私が連絡を受ける予定です。返事をもらったら参加者へ伝えますが、市の回答にないことは付け加えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分を回答連絡先とし回答内容を正確に共有すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I plan to receive the response. I will pass it on to the participants when it arrives, but I will not add anything that is not in the city’s reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will be the contact for the response and share its contents accurately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、担当の窓口へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will show you to the relevant counter. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付で確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 体調のメモを持ってきました。診察の前に渡した方がよいのか、自分で持っていた方がよいのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 体調メモを事前提出するか手元保管するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought notes about my health. I would like to know whether to hand them in before the consultation or keep them with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to submit your health notes beforehand or keep them with you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのような内容を記録されていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: めまいがあった日と、続いた時間です。何もなかった日も書いてあるので、長いメモになっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: めまい日と継続時間と無症状日を記録したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The days I felt dizzy and how long it lasted. I also wrote down days when nothing happened, so the notes are quite long.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you recorded days with dizziness, its duration, and days without symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お渡しする方法を担当に確認します。今、具合が悪いところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the staff how to hand them over. Are you feeling unwell anywhere now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今はありません。受付で全部読み上げるのではなく、診察で必要な部分を見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在は無症状で診察時に必要部分を見てほしいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not now. Rather than read everything aloud at reception, I would like the relevant parts to be looked at during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you currently have no symptoms and would like the relevant sections reviewed during the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の状態も担当へ伝えます。メモは原本だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will also tell the staff about your current condition. Do you only have the original notes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 原本だけです。預ける場合には、返してもらえるか先に確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原本のみなので預ける場合の返却確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, only the original. If I leave them with you, I would like to check beforehand whether I will get them back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you only have the original and want to confirm its return before leaving it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料の扱いを確認してご案内します。診察でご自身から説明する準備もしておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check how the documents are handled and let you know. Please also be ready to explain things yourself during the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。最初にいつから気になっているかを話し、細かい時間はメモで示します。渡し方の案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発症時期を口頭説明し時間はメモで示すと準備を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will first explain when I started noticing the problem and show the detailed times in my notes. I will wait for instructions on handing them over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to describe the onset orally and show the times in your notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。それでは、担当に確認します。こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check with the staff. Please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落ち着いてお話しください。何がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Take your time and tell me. What happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道で知らない人に何度もお金を貸してと言われ、怖くなりました。ここへ来たので相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 金銭要求を繰り返され怖くなり相談に来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A stranger on the street repeatedly asked me to lend them money, and I became frightened. I came here because I would like advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that repeated requests for money frightened you and brought you here for advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その方は今も近くにいますか。けがはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is that person still nearby? Are you injured?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は見えません。けがもありません。駅前の店まで離れて、店の方に電話を借りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手不在と無傷と店舗へ退避して電話を借りた経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I cannot see them now. I am not injured either. I moved away to a shop in front of the station and borrowed the shop staff’s phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the person is not in sight, you are unhurt, and you took refuge in a shop and borrowed a phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その後、こちらへ来られたのですね。何時ごろのことですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: And then you came here. About what time did this happen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三十分くらい前です。お金は渡していませんが、名前を聞かれて答えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三十分前で金銭未交付だが名前を答えたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: About thirty minutes ago. I did not give them money, but they asked my name and I answered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it was thirty minutes ago, you gave no money, but you did tell them your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 覚えている状況を順に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell me what you remember, in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手の名前は知りません。服と場所は覚えています。電話を借りた店の方にも見てもらったと思いますが、確認はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手の服と場所は覚えているが店側の目撃は未確認と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not know their name. I remember their clothes and the location. I think the staff at the shop where I borrowed the phone also saw them, but I have not checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you remember the person’s clothes and the location, but have not confirmed whether the shop staff witnessed it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身が見聞きしたことと、まだ確認できていないことを分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will ask separately about what you personally saw and heard and what has not yet been confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。店の方が全部見たとは言わず、私がされた声かけと、自分が答えたことから話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分が受けた声かけと回答から事実を説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not say the shop staff saw everything. I will start with what the person said to me and what I answered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain the facts, starting with what was said to you and how you replied. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、お話を伺います。相談後もお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will hear your account now. Please take care on your way home after the consultation as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの荷物は、今から発送されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending the parcel you have with you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達へ服と本を送ります。ただ、本はまだ選んでいないので、服だけ先に送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 服を先送りし本は未選定なので後送と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending clothes and books to a friend. However, I have not chosen the books yet, so I would like to send just the clothes first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about sending the clothes first and the books later because they have not been chosen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日お持ちの荷物は服だけですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the parcel you have brought today contains only clothes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。後から本も送るので、二つとも同じ日に着くようにしないと受け取れないか気になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日の内容は服のみで別送の受け取りが気になると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Since I will send the books later, I wondered whether my friend could only receive the two parcels if they arrived on the same day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that today’s parcel contains only clothes and you are concerned about receiving separate shipments. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 到着予定や受け取りの方法は荷物ごとに確認します。相手のご都合は分かっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the estimated arrival and collection options for each parcel. Do you know your friend’s availability?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 平日は留守が多いと聞いています。先に服を送ることを友達へ知らせて、受け取り方を相談してもらおうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手に先送を知らせ受け取り方法を相談してもらうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I hear they are often out on weekdays. I plan to tell my friend I am sending the clothes first and ask them to discuss how to receive them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will notify the recipient of the first shipment and ask them to discuss receipt arrangements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらでは今日の荷物に使える方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain the options available for today’s parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。本を一緒に入れた場合の重さではなく、今ある服の荷物で費用を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 将来の本を含めず現荷物の費用案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I would like to know the cost for the clothes I have now, rather than the weight if the books were included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the cost of the current parcel, excluding the future books. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この荷物を確認してご説明します。後の本は準備してから改めてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check this parcel and explain. Please consult us again about the books once they are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。今日は服だけで手続きして、二つの荷物の案内を混ぜないよう、それぞれ控えを残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 服だけ手続きし二件の控えを分けて残すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. Today I will send only the clothes and keep separate records so I do not mix up the information for the two parcels.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will process only the clothes and keep separate records for the two shipments. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、今日の荷物を確認します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check today’s parcel. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳の記入する場所について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about where to write in your bankbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家計のメモもここに書けば便利だと思いました。印字の横の空いた場所に書いても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家計メモを通帳余白に書く可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought it would be convenient to write household budget notes here too. Is it all right to write in the blank space beside the printed entries?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can write household budget notes in the margins of your bankbook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通帳へ書き込む前に、お取り扱いを確認します。どのようなメモですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before you write in it, I will check the handling instructions. What sort of notes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「家賃」や「食費」です。取引の説明と自分のメモが見分けられるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用途名を書き銀行印字と区別したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Things like rent and food expenses. I want to be able to distinguish the transaction descriptions from my own notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to write spending categories and distinguish them from the bank’s printing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通帳の印字とご自身の整理は、別の記録にする方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You could also keep your own organizational notes in a separate record from the printed bankbook entries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別のノートでもよさそうですね。通帳のページと取引の日付をノートに書けば、あとで照らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別ノートにページと取引日を記録する代案を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: A separate notebook sounds good too. If I write the bankbook page and transaction date in the notebook, I can compare them later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Consider the alternative of recording the page and transaction date in a separate notebook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その場合も、記録の保管にはお気をつけください。今、通帳に何か貼っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please take care when storing those records too. Have you attached anything to your bankbook now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 貼っていません。付箋を入れたまま機械へ通すつもりでしたが、取扱いを聞いてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未貼付で付箋入り機械使用をやめ取扱確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I had planned to put it through the machine with a sticky note inside, but I will ask about handling it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that nothing is attached and you will check the instructions before using the machine with a sticky note inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 機械を使う前に、通帳の状態を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the condition of your bankbook before using the machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は通帳に書いたり貼ったりせず、家計メモはノートに作ります。通帳の扱いは案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通帳未加工のままメモは別記録にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Today I will not write in or attach anything to the bankbook, and I will make my budget notes in a notebook. I will check the bankbook handling instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave the bankbook unaltered and keep your notes in a separate record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、お取り扱いをご説明します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will explain how to handle it. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の商品をお受け取りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect your reserved item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ケーキを頼みました。名前の文字を注文した時に間違えた気がするので、先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約ケーキの文字注文を間違えた疑いで確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I ordered a cake. I think I may have made a mistake with the name lettering when I ordered, so I would like to check first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check the lettering on your reserved cake because you suspect you ordered it incorrectly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文の控えと、ご予約のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I have your order receipt and the name on the reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これです。受け取るのは私ですが、ケーキに書くのは友達の名前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取人の自分とケーキ記名対象の友人を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. I am collecting it, but the name to be written on the cake is my friend’s.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish yourself as the person collecting it from your friend whose name goes on the cake. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 注文内容を確認します。正しい表記を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the order. Could you show me the correct spelling?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このメッセージです。発音だけで伝えたので、一文字違っているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正表記メッセージを示し口頭注文の一文字相違を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is in this message. I only gave the pronunciation, so one character may be wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the message with the correct spelling and explain that the spoken order may differ by one character. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品の準備状況と、今から対応できることを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the preparation status and what we can do at this point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。まだ箱を開けていません。できている文字を自分で触って直すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未開封で自分で文字を触って修正しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I have not opened the box yet. I do not intend to touch the finished lettering and fix it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the box is unopened and you will not touch and alter the lettering yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が確認してご案内します。必要な時間や費用もその後お伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person responsible will check and advise you. We will then tell you the time and cost required as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今すぐ直せると思わず説明を待ちます。友達には、受け取りが遅れるか確認してから連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 修正対応と時間費用の案内後に友人へ遅延連絡を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will wait for the explanation without assuming it can be fixed immediately. I will contact my friend after checking whether collection will be delayed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will decide whether to notify your friend of a delay after hearing about the correction, time, and cost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、担当へ確認します。こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check with the person responsible. Please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: すみません。通話のお声が、近くの方にもかなり聞こえています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Excuse me. People nearby can hear your voice on the call quite clearly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 気づきませんでした。家族と動画で話していて、声が大きくなっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族との動画通話で声が大きくなったと認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I had not realized. I was on a video call with my family, and my voice had become loud.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that your voice became loud during a video call with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の通話をいったん止めて、ご相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you pause the call so we can talk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、止めました。画面を見せるつもりはありませんでしたが、近くの人が映っているかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通話停止を知らせ周囲の映り込みも確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I have stopped it. I did not intend to show my screen to anyone, but I will also check whether people nearby are appearing in the picture.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have stopped the call and will check whether people around you are in view. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 周りの方への配慮もお願いします。長く話す予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please be considerate of people around you as well. Were you planning to talk for a long time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あと十分くらいでした。ここでは短く終えて、続きは帰宅してから話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残り十分を予定していたが続きは帰宅後にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: For about another ten minutes. I would like to finish briefly here and continue once I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you had planned another ten minutes but will continue after returning home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通話する場合も、周りの状況に合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please adapt to your surroundings when making calls as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。イヤホンを付ければ自分の声も小さくなると思っていましたが、声の大きさも気をつけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: イヤホン以外に自声の音量も配慮すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I thought wearing earphones would make my own voice quieter too, but I will pay attention to how loudly I speak as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will consider the volume of your own voice as well as using earphones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: よろしくお願いします。今は落ち着いて休憩されてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Please relax and enjoy your break now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。家族には家でかけ直すとメッセージを送り、ここでは通話を終えます。教えてくださってありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族へかけ直しを知らせ公園での通話を終えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will send my family a message saying I will call again at home, and end the call here. Thank you for letting me know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will notify your family you will call back and end the call in the park. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、ゆっくりお過ごしください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please enjoy your time here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その切符の内容を確認されたいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to check the details of that ticket, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達に頼まれて買いましたが、行き先を間違えたかもしれません。この切符の区間を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人用切符の購入区間を間違えた疑いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought it at my friend’s request, but I may have got the destination wrong. Could you tell me which route this ticket covers?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a possible mistake in the route you purchased for your friend’s ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お友達から頼まれた行き先は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the destination your friend requested?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メッセージに書いてあります。私は隣の駅の名前と読み違えたようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 依頼メッセージを示し隣駅名と読み違えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is written in a message. I seem to have misread it as the name of the neighboring station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the request message and explain that you misread it as the neighboring station’s name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切符とメッセージの行き先を確認しましょう。切符はまだ使っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the ticket and the destination in the message. Has the ticket been used yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使っていません。友達もまだ来ていないので、渡す前に気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切符未使用で友人に渡す前と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. My friend has not arrived yet either, so I noticed before handing it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the ticket is unused and you have not yet given it to your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更などの扱いについて、切符の条件を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the ticket conditions and explain how changes or other arrangements are handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。もう一枚買う前に、この切符をどうすればよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加購入前に現切符の扱いを確認したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Before buying another ticket, I would like to ask what I should do with this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check what to do with the existing ticket before buying an additional one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な手続きを説明します。お友達にも確認してから進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain the necessary procedures. Please check with your friend as well before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。行き先を文字で確認し、費用や手続きの説明を聞いてから対応します。変更できたかも友達へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 文字で行先確認し条件説明後に対応し結果を友人へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will confirm the destination in writing and act after hearing the explanation of costs and procedures. I will also tell my friend whether the change was possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm the destination in writing, act after the conditions are explained, and tell your friend the outcome. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、切符を確認します。お気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check the ticket. Have a safe trip.
